snippet.title: A Gentlemen's Dispute - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Be the last gentleman standing. Check out the latest A Gentlemen's Dispute trailer for this upcoming slapstick physics-based party brawler game to see gameplay and more. Fling your own ragdoll as a weapon to knock around and throw enemy players. Stack insane perks and wield preposterous items to cause maximum chaos. Anything it takes to prove yourself the most gentlemanly of them all! A Gentlemen's Dispute will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
